title: The Yemen war is not just Saudi Arabia’s problem. It’s the Gulf’s too
gist: Renewed full-scale war in Yemen, with Houthi strikes on Riyadh, Abha and Dammam airports and Saudi oil infrastructure, shows Saudi Arabia can neither win militarily nor outsource the conflict to the US or its Turkey/Pakistan defence pact. Chatham House argues the Houthis are a collective GCC security threat to Gulf diversification agendas and calls for Saudi-UAE reconciliation, redirecting aid from the PLC to the government, and a Gulf-backed settlement for a unified but decentralized Yemen.
